en:
<CLT=cltMIND>We decided to hang out
in the courtyard.

<CLT=cltMIND>It looks like we're the only ones here...
What should we do?
Let's play catch
Let's run a marathon
Let's blow bubbles
Degenerate males never grow up, do they?

How could you like childish games even
at this age?
Just looking at you makes me sad...

Wh-Why do degenerates try to challenge
things they can't do?

You should run somewhere far, far away
from me!
Run forward and never turn back!

Bubbles are great!
They're pretty and they always calm me!

I dream of blowing a huge bubble, and
then just sitting in the center of it!

But it's unfortunate that bubbles disappear
so quickly...

It would be great if degenerate males
disappeared instead...

But I guess part of what makes bubbles so
beautiful is its fragility!

I love everything about bubbles with
all my heart!

<CLT=cltMIND>I wonder what's wrong?
Tenko looks deep in thought...
<CLT=cltMIND>Huh?
<CLT=cltMIND>That voice just now. Is that...?
<CLT=cltMIND>Is that Tenko's inner thoughts...?
